blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Halogenoalkanes) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I) Which of the following compound is a primary halogenoalkane?
(In mein se kaun sa compound primary halogenoalkane hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1-bromo-2,2-dimethylpropane, (CH₃)₃C–CH₂–Br, mein Br wala carbon sirf aik carbon se juda hai, is liye primary hai. 2-bromo-3-methylbutane aur 2-bromopropane secondary hain (do carbons se jude); 2-bromo-2-methylpropane tertiary hai (teen carbons).

blocks.prompt:
II) The reactivity order of halogenoalkanes for a particular alkyl group is:
(Aik hi alkyl group ke liye halogenoalkanes ki reactivity ki tarteeb kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reactivity C–X bond ki mazbooti se tay hoti hai: C–I 228 < C–Br 290 < C–Cl 346 < C–F 467 kJ mol⁻¹. Sab se kamzor bond sab se aasani se toot-ta hai, is liye R–I > R–Br > R–Cl > R–F.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (b) ghalat chhapa hai: is mein Chloride do baar likha hai aur Iodide ghayab hai (“Chloride > Bromide > Fluoride > Chloride”). Yeh har haal mein ghalat option hai; key (c) par asar nahi.

blocks.prompt:
III) SN2 reactions can be best carried out with:
(SN2 reactions sab se behtar kis ke saath hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Primary halogenoalkanes mein X wala carbon H atoms ya sirf aik carbon se juda hota hai, is liye rukawat (steric hindrance) kam hai aur nucleophile peeche se aasani se hamla karta hai. Primary hamesha SN2 follow karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
IV) Elimination bimolecular reactions involve:
(Elimination bimolecular (E2) reactions mein kaun si kinetics hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: E2: Rate = k [Alkyl halide]¹[Base]¹, order = 1 + 1 = 2, yani second order kinetics.

blocks.prompt:
V) For which mechanisms, the first step involved is the same:
(Kin mechanisms mein pehla qadam aik jaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: SN1 aur E1 dono mein pehla (aahista, rate-determining) qadam alkyl halide ka ionization hai jis se carbocation aur X⁻ bante hain. Phir nucleophile carbocation par hamla karta hai (SN1) ya base β-H hatata hai (E1). E2 aur SN2 aik qadam wale hain.

blocks.prompt:
VI) Halogenoalkanes are considered to be very reactive compounds towards nucleophiles, because:
(Halogenoalkanes nucleophiles ke liye bohat reactive kyun samjhe jaate hain?)

options.text: Un mein electrophilic carbon aur achha leaving group hai
Un mein electrophilic carbon aur bura leaving group hai
Un mein nucleophilic carbon aur achha leaving group hai

blocks.explanation: Polar C–X bond ki wajah se carbon par partial positive charge hota hai (electrophilic carbon) jo nucleophiles ko kheenchta hai, aur halide ion aasani se nikal jata hai (good leaving group), is liye substitution aasani se hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
VII) 2-chloropropane will follow which mechanism when it reacts with aqueous KOH resulting in the formation of an alcohol.
(2-chloropropane aqueous KOH se alcohol banate waqt kaun sa mechanism follow karega?)
blocks.explanation: 2-chloropropane, CH₃–CHCl–CH₃, secondary halogenoalkane hai. Secondary halogenoalkanes solvent ke mutabiq SN2 aur SN1 dono se react kar sakte hain, is liye alcohol (propan-2-ol) mixed SN1 aur SN2 se banta hai. E1 se alkene banti hai, alcohol nahi.

blocks.prompt:
VIII) Which one of the following is not a nucleophile?
(In mein se kaun nucleophile nahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleophile ke paas dene ke liye lone pair (ya negative charge) hota hai. H₂O, H₂S aur NH₃ mein lone pairs hain. BF₃ mein B par koi lone pair nahi; boron electron deficient hai (6 electrons), is liye BF₃ electrons leta hai: yeh electrophile (Lewis acid) hai.

blocks.prompt:
IX) When aqueous solution of alkyl halides are reacted with AgNO₃, the most rapid ppt. formation occurs with:
(Alkyl halides ko aqueous AgNO₃ se milane par sab se tez precipitate kis se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: C–I sab se kamzor bond hai (228 kJ mol⁻¹), is liye iodoalkane sab se tez hydrolyse ho kar I⁻ deta hai; Ag⁺ + I⁻ → AgI (chamakdar peela ppt) sab se pehle banta hai. Chloroalkane bohat aahista react karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
X) The rate of E1 reaction depends upon:
(E1 reaction ka rate kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: Substrate aur base dono ka concentration
Na substrate na base ka concentration

blocks.explanation: E1 unimolecular hai: aahista ionization wale qadam mein sirf alkyl halide shamil hai, is liye Rate = k [Alkyl halide]; base rate-determining step mein shamil nahi.

blocks.prompt:
a) Why halogenoalkanes are known to be very reactive compounds?
Halogenoalkanes bohat reactive compounds kyun kehlaate hain?
blocks.explanation: Electronegativity ke farq se C–X bond polar hai: carbon par δ+ aata hai aur woh electrophilic markaz ban jata hai jis par nucleophiles hamla karte hain, aur X⁻ achha leaving group hai. Base β-hydrogen bhi hata sakta hai. Is liye yeh aasani se nucleophilic substitution aur elimination reactions dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
b) Why fluoroalkanes rarely undergo nucleophilic substitution reactions?
Fluoroalkanes nucleophilic substitution bohat kam kyun karte hain?
blocks.explanation: C–F bond sab se mazboot carbon–halogen bond hai (467 kJ mol⁻¹; C–Cl 346, C–Br 290, C–I 228). Yeh itna mazboot hai ke aam halaat mein nahi toot-ta, is liye fluoroalkanes sab se kam reactive hain.

blocks.prompt:
c) Why primary halogenoalkanes undergo substitution reactions by SN2 mechanism?
Primary halogenoalkanes SN2 mechanism se substitution kyun karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Primary halogenoalkane mein X wala carbon H atoms ya sirf aik carbon se juda hai (rukawat kam), is liye nucleophile leaving group ke mukhalif taraf se aik hi qadam mein aasani se hamla karta hai. Primary carbocation sab se kam stable hai, is liye SN1 ka raasta pasand nahi hota.

blocks.prompt:
d) Does 1-bromo-2,2-dimethylpropane undergo elimination reaction or not? Justify.
Kya 1-bromo-2,2-dimethylpropane elimination reaction karta hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Is ka structure (CH₃)₃C–CH₂–Br hai. β-elimination ke liye β-carbon (C–Br ke saath wala carbon) par hydrogen zaroori hai. Yahan β-carbon teen CH₃ groups aur CH₂Br se juda hai aur us par koi hydrogen nahi, is liye HBr nahi nikal sakta aur alkene nahi banti.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: β-carbon: woh carbon jo halogen wale (α) carbon ke bilkul saath juda ho. Elimination mein H isi β-carbon se nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
e) Why tertiary halogenoalkanes undergo elimination reaction by E1 mechanism?
Tertiary halogenoalkanes E1 mechanism se elimination kyun karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Tertiary halogenoalkane aasani se ionize ho kar tertiary carbocation banata hai jo sab se stable carbocation hai (teen alkyl groups ka +I effect). Teen bhaari groups aik qadam wale hamle ko bhi rokte hain. Is liye pehle aahista qadam mein carbocation banta hai, phir base β-H hata kar alkene banata hai: E1 raasta.

blocks.prompt:
f) Hydroxide ion is a good base as well as a good nucleophile. Justify.
Hydroxide ion achha base bhi hai aur achha nucleophile bhi. Sabit karein.
blocks.explanation: OH⁻ par negative charge aur lone pairs hain. Nucleophile ke tor par yeh electrophilic carbon par hamla kar ke X ki jagah leta hai: C₂H₅Br + NaOH(aq) → C₂H₅OH + NaBr. Base ke tor par β-hydrogen hatata hai: C₂H₅Br + NaOH (alcohol) → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O + NaBr. Is liye bromoethane se ethanol aur ethene dono bante hain.

blocks.prompt:
g) What is the role of iron chloride (FeCl₃) during the chlorination of benzene?
Benzene ki chlorination mein iron chloride (FeCl₃) ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Anhydrous FeCl₃ is electrophilic aromatic substitution ka catalyst hai, room temperature par: C₆H₆ + Cl₂ → (FeCl₃) C₆H₅Cl + HCl. Lewis acid ke tor par yeh Cl₂ ko polarise kar ke electrophile Cl⁺ deta hai (Cl₂ + FeCl₃ → Cl⁺ + FeCl₄⁻) jo ring par hamla karta hai (Cl⁺ wala qadam chapter se aage hai).

blocks.prompt:
h) Which among haloalkanes or haloarenes, is more reactive towards nucleophiles?
Haloalkanes aur haloarenes mein se nucleophiles ke liye kaun zyada reactive hai?
blocks.explanation: Haloalkanes zyada reactive hain. Haloarenes mein halogen ka lone pair benzene ring mein phail jata hai (delocalised), jis se C–X bond mein partial double-bond character aata hai; bond mazboot aur mushkil se toot-ne wala ho jata hai, is liye haloarenes nucleophiles ke saath bohat kam reactive hain.

blocks.prompt:
i) Write the equation for the reaction of 1-chloropropane with AgNO₃.
1-chloropropane ka AgNO₃ ke saath reaction ki equation likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Water–ethanol mein pani Cl ki jagah leta hai, aur nikalne wala Cl⁻ safed precipitate deta hai (aahista):
CH₃CH₂CH₂Cl + H₂O → CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + H⁺ + Cl⁻
Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ → AgCl (safed ppt)
Majmooi: CH₃CH₂CH₂Cl + AgNO₃ + H₂O → CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + AgCl↓ + HNO₃

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar jawab likhein)

blocks.prompt:
a) Predict the mechanism which the chloroalkane will adopt while giving nucleophilic substitution reactions.
Chloroalkane nucleophilic substitution mein kaun sa mechanism apnayega? Andaza lagayein.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh chloroalkane ki qisam par munhasir hai:
• Primary (maslan CH₃CH₂Cl): SN2. Rukawat kam, nucleophile peeche se aik qadam mein hamla karta hai; Rate = k [RCl][Nu⁻].
• Tertiary (maslan (CH₃)₃CCl): SN1. Stable tertiary carbocation banta hai; bhaari groups peeche ka hamla rokte hain; Rate = k [RCl].
• Secondary (maslan CH₃CHClCH₃): solvent ke mutabiq SN1 ya SN2 (mixed).

blocks.prompt:
b) Why nucleophilic substitution and elimination reactions of haloalkanes proceed together under similar conditions?
Haloalkanes ke nucleophilic substitution aur elimination reactions aik jaise halaat mein saath saath kyun hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Aik hi reagent (maslan OH⁻) nucleophile bhi hai aur base bhi. Haloalkane mein δ+ carbon par yeh nucleophile ban kar hamla karta hai (substitution → alcohol), aur β-hydrogen ko base ban kar hatata hai (elimination → alkene). Dono jagah aik hi molecule mein hain, is liye dono reactions muqabla karte hain; maslan bromoethane aur NaOH se ethanol aur ethene dono. Halaat main product tay karte hain: aqueous NaOH se substitution, alcohol mein NaOH se elimination.

blocks.prompt:
c) It is difficult for chlorobenzene to undergo nucleophilic substitution reactions but it is easier for it to undergo electrophilic substitution reactions. Give reasons.
Chlorobenzene ke liye nucleophilic substitution mushkil magar electrophilic substitution aasaan kyun hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Nucleophilic substitution mushkil: Cl ka lone pair ring mein phail jata hai, is liye C–Cl bond mein partial double-bond character aa jata hai aur woh mazboot hai; aam halaat mein nahi toot-ta (NaOH se reaction nahi). Electron se bhari ring hamla karne wale nucleophile ko door bhi dhakelti hai.
Electrophilic substitution aasaan: benzene ring mein delocalised π electrons ka badal hai jo electrophiles ko kheenchta hai, aur Cl ka ring mein dhakela gaya lone pair electron density barhata hai. Substitution se stable aromatic ring qaim rehti hai, is liye electrophiles (Cl⁺, NO₂⁺ waghera) ring ka H badal dete hain (electrophilic hissa chapter se aage hai).

blocks.prompt:
d) Differentiate between E2 and E1 reactions. Draw a table for your response.
E2 aur E1 reactions mein farq batayein. Jawab table mein dein.
blocks.explanation: Dono HX nikaal kar alkene banate hain; farq qadmon ki tadaad aur rate kis par munhasir hai, us mein hai.

rows: Aik qadam: base β-H hatata hai aur X⁻ saath hi nikalta hai
Do qadam: pehle aahista ionization, phir base β-H hatata hai

blocks.prompt:
e) Why does CH₃-CH₂-I give a precipitate with aqueous silver nitrate earlier than CH₃-CH₂-Cl?
CH₃-CH₂-I aqueous silver nitrate ke saath CH₃-CH₂-Cl se pehle precipitate kyun deta hai?
blocks.explanation: C–I bond (228 kJ mol⁻¹) C–Cl (346 kJ mol⁻¹) se bohat kamzor hai, is liye iodoethane jaldi hydrolyse ho kar I⁻ deta hai: Ag⁺ + I⁻ → AgI (chamakdar peela ppt) foran banta hai. Chloroethane Cl⁻ bohat aahista deta hai, is liye safed AgCl ppt der se banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Describe how substitution of alcohol with following reagents help to synthesize halogenoalkanes
i) KBr with H₂SO₄  ii) SOCl₂/Pyridine  iii) PCl₃  iv) PCl₅
Alcohol ke –OH ko darj zail reagents se badal kar halogenoalkanes kaise banaye jaate hain? Bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Har case mein alcohol ka –OH group halogen atom se badal jata hai.
i) KBr aur H₂SO₄: acid KBr se HBr banata hai, jo phir alcohol ko bromoalkane mein badalta hai.
CH₃–CH₂–OH + KBr + H₂SO₄ → CH₃–CH₂–Br + H₂O + KHSO₄
Yeh tareeqa bromoalkanes aur iodoalkanes ke liye hai; iodoalkanes ke liye H₃PO₄ behtar hai kyun ke yeh kamzor oxidizing agent hai aur I⁻ ko I₂ nahi banata.
ii) SOCl₂/pyridine: thionyl chloride, pyridine catalyst ke saath, chloroalkane deta hai.
CH₃–CH₂–OH + SOCl₂ → (pyridine) CH₃–CH₂–Cl + SO₂ + HCl
By-products SO₂ aur HCl gases hain aur ur jaati hain, khalis product bachta hai; is liye yeh behtareen tareeqa hai.
iii) PCl₃: phosphorus trichloride teen –OH groups badalta hai.
3CH₃–CH₂–OH + PCl₃ → 3CH₃–CH₂–Cl + H₃PO₃
(Kitab yeh reaction PBr₃ se dikhati hai: 3CH₃CH₂OH + PBr₃ → 3CH₃CH₂Br + H₃PO₃.)
iv) PCl₅: phosphorus pentachloride.
CH₃–CH₂–OH + PCl₅ → CH₃–CH₂–Cl + POCl₃ + HCl
(Alcohols HCl aur ZnCl₂ catalyst se bhi chloroalkane dete hain: CH₃CH₂OH + HCl → (ZnCl₂) CH₃CH₂Cl + H₂O.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: SOCl₂ wala tareeqa sab se achha kyun? Kyun ke SO₂ aur HCl dono gases hain, khud nikal jaati hain, aur product ko alag karne ki zaroorat nahi parti.

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Describe nucleophilic substitution reactions of halogenoalkane starting from bromoethane with following reagents:
i) Aqueous NaOH  ii) Ethanolic KCN  iii) Ethanolic NH₃
Bromoethane se shuru kar ke darj zail reagents ke saath nucleophilic substitution reactions bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Har reaction mein nucleophile CH₃–CH₂–Br ke δ+ carbon par hamla karta hai aur Br⁻ nikal jata hai.
i) Aqueous NaOH: OH⁻ achha nucleophile hai; reflux par garam karne se (taake urne wale products zaya na hon) ethanol banta hai.
CH₃–CH₂–Br + NaOH(aq) → CH₃–CH₂–OH + NaBr
OH⁻ achha base bhi hai, is liye kuch elimination bhi hota hai (alcohol mein ethene): CH₃–CH₂–Br + NaOH (alcohol) → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O + NaBr.
ii) Ethanolic KCN: CN⁻ taqatwar nucleophile magar kamzor base hai, is liye sirf substitution hota hai. Bromoethane ko ethanolic KCN ke saath reflux par garam karne se propanenitrile banta hai (carbon chain aik C barh jati hai).
CH₃–CH₂–Br + KCN → (alcohol) CH₃–CH₂–C≡N + KBr
iii) Ethanolic NH₃: N ka lone pair carbon par hamla karta hai; ethanamine banta hai.
CH₃–CH₂–Br + NH₃ → CH₃–CH₂–NH₂ + HBr
Ethanamine bhi nucleophile hai aur aage react karta hai:
C₂H₅NH₂ + C₂H₅Br → (C₂H₅)₂NH (N-ethylethanamine) + HBr
(C₂H₅)₂NH + C₂H₅Br → (C₂H₅)₃N (N,N-diethylethanamine) + HBr
Bromoethane bohat zyada ho to quaternary ammonium salt banta hai:
(C₂H₅)₃N + C₂H₅Br → [(C₂H₅)₄N]⁺Br⁻
Bromoethane aur ammonia ki miqdar control kar ke matloob amine hasil hoti hai (NH₃ zyada ho to zyada tar ethanamine).

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Compare the reactivity of halogenoalkanes and halogenoarenes using chloroethane and chlorobenzene as examples.
Chloroethane aur chlorobenzene ki misal se halogenoalkanes aur halogenoarenes ki reactivity ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Chloroethane mein C–Cl bond polar hai; δ+ carbon par nucleophiles aur β-H par bases hamla karte hain, is liye yeh aasani se substitution aur elimination deta hai (maslan CH₃CH₂Cl + NaOH(aq) → CH₃CH₂OH + NaCl). Chlorobenzene mein Cl ka lone pair benzene ring mein phail jata hai; C–Cl bond mein partial double-bond character aa jata hai, bond mazboot aur mushkil se toot-ne wala ho jata hai. Is liye chlorobenzene aam halaat mein NaOH se react nahi karta, elimination nahi karta, aur kam reactive aur synthesis mein kam mufeed hai.

rows: Cl sp³ alkyl carbon se juda hai
Cl benzene ring ke carbon se juda hai
Cl ka lone pair Cl par hi rehta hai
Cl ka lone pair ring mein phail jata hai (delocalised)
C–Cl bond kamzor, aasani se toot-ta hai
C–Cl bond mazboot, mushkil se toot-ta hai
Nucleophiles ke saath bohat kam reactive
Aam halaat mein NaOH se reaction nahi

blocks.prompt:
Q7. Describe the SN1 and SN2 mechanisms of nucleophilic substitution in halogenoalkanes.
Halogenoalkanes mein nucleophilic substitution ke SN1 aur SN2 mechanisms bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Nucleophilic substitution mein do kaam hote hain: C–X bond ka toot-na (leaving group ka nikalna) aur C–Nu bond ka banna (nucleophile ka hamla). Agar dono aik hi qadam mein saath hon to SN2; agar pehle bond toote aur doosre qadam mein naya bane to SN1.
SN2 (nucleophilic substitution bimolecular), maslan bromomethane + OH⁻:
1. OH⁻ CH₃–Br ke δ+ carbon par Br ke mukhalif taraf se hamla karta hai.
2. Jaise hi C–O bond banna shuru hota hai, C–Br bond toot-na shuru hota hai (banna = toot-na). Transition state [HO···CH₃···Br]⁻ banti hai jis mein carbon OH aur Br dono se adha juda hota hai.
3. Br⁻ nikal jata hai aur methanol banta hai; teen H atoms doosri taraf palat jaate hain.
CH₃Br + OH⁻ → CH₃OH + Br⁻
Aik qadam, jo rate-determining hai, aur us mein do molecules: Rate = k [Alkyl halide]¹[Nucleophile]¹, order 2. Primary halogenoalkanes hamesha SN2 follow karte hain (rukawat kam).
SN1 (nucleophilic substitution unimolecular), maslan 2-bromo-2-methylpropane + OH⁻ (aqueous acetone ya aqueous ethanol mein):
Qadam 1 (aahista): reversible ionization: (CH₃)₃C–Br ⇌ (CH₃)₃C⁺ + Br⁻ (flat tertiary carbocation).
Qadam 2 (tez): OH⁻ carbocation par hamla karta hai: (CH₃)₃C⁺ + OH⁻ → (CH₃)₃C–OH.
Qadam 1 mein covalent bond toot-ta hai, is liye yeh aahista aur rate-determining hai; sirf aik molecule shamil: Rate = k [Alkyl halide], first order. Tertiary halogenoalkanes hamesha SN1 follow karte hain kyun ke tertiary carbocation sab se stable hai (+I effect; stability 3° > 2° > 1° > methyl) aur teen bhaari groups peeche se hamla rokte hain. Secondary halogenoalkanes solvent ke mutabiq dono follow kar sakte hain.

rows: Koi intermediate nahi; transition state HO···C···Br
Pehle bond toot-ta hai, phir naya banta hai
Bond toot-na aur banna saath saath

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: SN2 mein '2' = rate do cheezon (substrate + nucleophile) par; SN1 mein '1' = rate sirf substrate par. Carbocation sirf SN1 (aur E1) mein banta hai.
